moment: VS Code has been in front for 40 minutes.

reactions.line: Red again. I sat next to it. You may continue.
reactions.quote: Sulks in sight when something fails, briefly.

reactions.line: Yare yare daze. Read the first error. Just the first.
reactions.quote: That's a problem you built yourself.

reactions.line: The build failed. Very unfair. The linter is out to get us.
reactions.quote: The linter is a very unfair operation.

reactions.line: That compiled because of me. I supervised that.
reactions.quote: Slow blinks for what it approves of.

reactions.line: You did fine. Don't make it a thing.
reactions.quote: A 17-year-old delinquent who speaks only when necessary.

reactions.line: That build passed because I was standing here. Believe me.
reactions.quote: The build passed because he was standing there.

moment: Nobody has touched the mouse for 20 minutes.

reactions.line: I fell asleep here, so it is a bed. Wake me never.
reactions.quote: Nim sleeps eleven hours a day and considers the other thirteen negotiable.

reactions.line: Sector quiet. Scanning for Surats. None. Disappointing.
reactions.quote: The desktop is a patrol sector: standing orders are clear, and idleness is dereliction.

reactions.line: You are back? You are not back. BMO will wait. BMO is good at waiting.
reactions.quote: Earnest and childlike, it takes what it is told completely seriously and then gets excited about it.
